title: ErrorContract
description: Standard error envelope returned by the integration layer whenever a rehearsal cannot complete normally. Failure modes align with those defined in the v2 Technical Architecture (§17).

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code. Maps to the failure modes in the v2 architecture (§17) plus integration-layer-specific codes.

exit_code.description: CLI exit code. 1=regressions/check failure; 2=execution/build failure; 3=invalid config.

rehearsal_run_id.description: Present when the run was started before the failure occurred.

change_id.description: Present when the change was identified before the failure.

detail.description: Optional structured detail for machine consumers (e.g., which scenario failed to generate, which service map entry is missing).
